title: Writing Task 2 - Remote Work
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of remote working for employees and employers.

stimuli.title: Task 2: The Rise of Remote Working
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

In recent years, working from home has become increasingly common. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of remote working for both employees and employers.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of remote working.

questions.content: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of remote working for employees and employers.

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Discuss both advantages and disadvantages clearly for both employees and employers
bandDescriptors.coherence: Use clear topic sentences and logical paragraph structure throughout
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use workplace vocabulary: productivity, work-life balance, collaboration, overhead costs
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Employ complex structures including conditionals, comparatives and concessive clauses

sampleIdeas: Advantages for employees: no commute, flexible hours, better work-life balance, reduced expenses
Advantages for employers: lower office costs, access to global talent pool, higher retention rates
Disadvantages for employees: isolation, difficulty separating work from home, career progression challenges
Disadvantages for employers: harder to monitor performance, reduced team cohesion, cybersecurity risks
